data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Aikaterina', which means 'pure, clear' and 'honor, respect'. The name Cthrine symbolizes grace, purification, and the Christian virtue of honor. The name Cthrine carries the meaning “Grace, Purification” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cthrine usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, purification and live with faith, good character and purpose.
